title: Health Care Accreditation Council (HCAC) - Accredited Organizations
notes: All tables on the "Accredited Organizations" page (EN + AR, fetched 2026-10-24): hospitals (MoH 21, RMS 8, university 2, NGO 1, private 17), MoH primary health care centres by governorate (+4 other-sector centres), certified breast-imaging units, medical laboratories, ambulatory centres, Baby-Friendly hospital certifications, blood banks and one prehospital organisation. One record per table row - a hospital accredited AND certified Baby-Friendly appears twice (one accreditation each) and must be merged downstream. Names and dates come from the English page; name_ar is paired from the Arabic page within the same table: same position AND same accreditation date, else the single unused Arabic row with the same date; otherwise name_ar is left empty (row order differs between the language versions, e.g. Istiklal is row 5 in Arabic and row 17 in English, and some dates disagree, e.g. Al Ramtha 2022 vs 2023). The Arabic date is kept in extra.date_ar_raw. Rows marked "(The Accreditation is Suspended)" carry status "suspended"; rows HCAC commented out of the HTML (expired/suspended history) were ignored. The date is the accreditation (or certification) date as listed - HCAC does not publish expiry, so accredited status is as-of the page, not verified per facility. Breast-imaging rows are certified units, typed "other" with extra.unit; their name is the host facility as written. Ownership comes from the HCAC sector tab; Biolab/MedLabs/private lab tabs are private. "Al Ramtha GOVERNORATE" and "Petra" PHC headings were mapped to Irbid and Ma'an governorates. A duplicate "Military Cancer Center blood bank" table under the prehospital heading was skipped. Unparseable dates are left in extra.date_raw. Unpaired English rows (no Arabic name): MedLabs Consultancy Group/Irbid 4; Al Tewal Al Janoubi Health Care Center
